resources.string: Just swipe a finger down over the home button to unlock your tablet, authorize purchases, or sign in to apps. Be careful whose fingerprints you add. Even one added print can do any of these things.\n\nNote: Your fingerprint may be less secure than a strong pattern or PIN.
It’s the home button below the screen. Swipe your finger down over it.
Swipe your finger down over the home button, slowly and straight, then lift it
Keep swiping to add the different parts of your fingerprint
Swipe down over the home button below the screen. Use your index finger.
Lift your finger, then swipe again
